title: Architecture
use: System components and their principal connections.

title: Architecture board
use: Show the full system, its layers, runtime path, and responsibilities.

title: Architecture delta
use: Show what a change removes, adds, and keeps in a system.

title: Flowchart
use: A decision branch where each edge changes the outcome.

title: Quadrant
use: Position items against two independent criteria.

title: Bar chart
use: Compare category magnitudes with one meaningful emphasis.

title: Line chart
use: Show a time series whose direction and inflections matter.

title: Stacked chart
use: Compare the composition of totals across categories.

title: Donut chart
use: Show a whole divided into a few clearly labeled parts.

title: State machine
use: Finite states and the events that transition between them.

title: Timeline
use: Milestones where order and elapsed time carry meaning.
example: timeline({ events: [{ title: "detect", date: "09:10" }, { title: "contain", date: "09:18" }, { title: "repair", date: "09:31" }, { title: "close", date: "09:42" }], summary: "Detection led to containment, repair, and closure." })

title: Gantt
use: Plan phases on a time axis with dependencies and today’s position.

title: Swimlane
use: A process crossing responsibilities or system boundaries.

title: Tree
use: Parent-child hierarchy such as modules, teams, or directories.

title: Fishbone
use: Group an incident’s causes by category and mark the confirmed root cause.

title: Dependency graph
use: Directed dependencies among modules, with one cycle or hotspot.

title: Layer stack
use: Vertically ordered layers and the contracts between them.

title: Venn
use: Meaningful overlap among two or three bounded sets.

title: Candlestick
use: Open-high-low-close movement where ranges matter.

title: Waterfall
use: Show how additions and deductions change the starting total into the ending total.

title: Heatmap
use: Intensity across two categories, such as failures by service and day.

title: Sequence
use: Messages among participants ordered from top to bottom.

title: Class
use: Types, their fields and methods, and inheritance.

title: Entity relationship
use: Records, keys, and the cardinality between them.
